subject: ist-s-algn
title: IST.S.ALGN.------MT.INFO.
description: First of two diagrams in CS-14 (Composite Science, section 14). The following prose discusses how 'the affinity adaptation of western science has moved to advance the nature of aspect-essence perception dynamics.' The crossing diagrams how isolated systematic alignment structurally meets multi-information at the aspect-essence-perception scale: (C)IST-S-ALGN (the concept of isolated systematic alignment) crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information). IST-S-ALGN sits on the left with the subject-arrow; MT-INTR (multiple interpretation) at upper-center and (P)RE-DIFF (physical-universe redefinition difference) at upper-right with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) below as partner-side upper outputs. INFO-DY (information dynamics) at center-right with IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) at lower-right as the partner-side downward chain. EXP-DY (exposure dynamics) sits centrally, SPTC-D (spectacle diversion) at lower-left, MT-INFO-DB (multi-information feedback double-bind) at lower-center. Structural argument: the upper diagonal MT-INTR -> (P)RE-DIFF -> T-C-IMP is the western-science capture route - multiple-interpretation routes through physical redefinition-difference into time-continuum-implications. The form's isolated systematic alignment reaches multi-information only when EXP-DY's central bridging hub holds open against the partner-axis's downward chain through INFO-DY -> IF-ST-DY -> DYM-F.
